tadalafil.label: Tadalafil

prices.included: Provider visit and shipping included. Cash-pay, no insurance.

tadalafil.mechanism: PDE5 inhibitor. Blocks the enzyme that breaks down cGMP so blood-vessel smooth muscle in the penis can relax with sexual stimulation. Does not cause arousal on its own.
tadalafil.safety_on_screen: Do not take with nitrates or riociguat. Seek emergency care for an erection lasting over 4 hours or sudden vision or hearing loss. Common side effects: headache, flushing, upset stomach, back or muscle aches. Tell your provider your full medical history.
tadalafil.safety_short: Rx only. Not for use with nitrates. Prescribing is never guaranteed.
tadalafil.photo_note: Real bottle photo is at photo_labeled. Its label reads 'Generic Cialis' / 'Generic Viagra' (brand name on screen). Default is to NOT use it; set config.use_labeled_photos=true only with compliance sign-off. When off, videos show the Beema mark instead.

ed-mints.label: ED Mints
formulations: Tadalafil + sildenafil 12 mg / 60 mg RDT (rapidly dissolving tablet)
Sildenafil 50 mg / tadalafil 20 mg / oxytocin 125 IU ODT (orally dissolving tablet)
ed-mints.directions_page_wording: Dissolve under the tongue, no water needed. Most patients take one about 30 minutes before sexual activity, no more than one dose in 24 hours. Provider confirms timing and dosing. Medicines do not cause arousal by themselves.
ed-mints.directions_status: PAGE_WORDING_ONLY. Matt asked about '30 to 60 minutes'; the live page says 'about 30 minutes'. Not yet verified against pharmacy documentation (Pharmacy Formularies/Optimal Balance Formulary.pdf not machine-read). Do not say 30-60 until confirmed. Never transfer tablet onset/duration claims to Mints.
ed-mints.disclosure_required: ED Mints are compounded at an FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility. They are not FDA-approved and are considered only when legally available and clinically appropriate.
ed-mints.mechanism: Combination PDE5-inhibitor formulations that dissolve under the tongue instead of being swallowed.
ed-mints.safety_on_screen: Compounded, not FDA-approved. Do not take with nitrates or riociguat. Seek emergency care for an erection lasting over 4 hours or sudden vision or hearing loss. Tell your provider your full medical history.
ed-mints.safety_short: Compounded, not FDA-approved. Rx only. Not for use with nitrates. Prescribing is never guaranteed.

semaglutide.label: Compounded semaglutide

prices.note: Prices intentionally NOT used in creative: plans/promos are complex and FDA says price cannot justify compounding. Link to the page.

semaglutide.disclosure_required: Compounded semaglutide is not FDA-approved and is considered only when legally available and clinically appropriate.
semaglutide.mechanism: GLP-1 receptor agonist. Acts on appetite and fullness signaling in the brain and slows stomach emptying.
semaglutide.safety_on_screen: Compounded, not FDA-approved. Prescription required. Possible side effects include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation. Serious risks include pancreatitis, gallbladder problems, and thyroid C-cell tumor warnings on approved GLP-1 labels. Not for people with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid cancer or MEN 2. Tell your provider your full history.
semaglutide.safety_short: Compounded, not FDA-approved. Rx only. Prescribing is never guaranteed.
